notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Berkshire Hathaway Inc;Financials;107702764241;9483089298;1.49%;0.49%". NBIM: NBIM's row gives voting 1.49% and ownership 0.49% for Berkshire Hathaway; we use the ownership figure as published. CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: Class basis: Berkshire's Class A and Class B are not economically equal (a Class B share has 1/1,500 of a Class A share's dividend and distribution rights), so this is CalPERS's Class B holding as a share of Class B only. CalPERS also reported 717 Class A shares (CUSIP 084670108, value $488,219,640), not included here. Holders of record: Class B (BRK.B) only; Class A has approximately 1,100 record holders.
